title: Melodi Pinggir Air
theme: Menemukan keindahan dan koneksi tak terduga dalam rutinitas harian serta bagaimana observasi sederhana dapat menumbuhkan sebuah perasaan yang hangat.

cover.prompt: Early dawn by a tranquil river, a gentle glow of golden light spreading across the peaceful landscape. Serene environment with soft morning light touching dew-kissed leaves in the foreground. Subtle silhouettes of distant city skyscrapers rise against the brightening sky. A mirrorless camera is positioned thoughtfully in the frame, hinting at a moment of visual meditation. Focus on the quiet atmosphere and the delicate interplay of natural light.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: The story follows Risa, an amateur photographer who finds solace in documenting her city's awakening by the river. Her routine is subtly altered when she observes a serene flower vendor, whose gentle dedication to his craft sparks her quiet curiosity. After months of observing from afar, a rainy morning provides a turning point: Risa spontaneously photographs the vendor, leading to a silent, heartfelt exchange of smiles. Breaking her observer role, Risa buys flowers, signaling the beginning of a new connection and a fresh, hopeful melody in her life.
meta.target_emotion: warmth, peaceful reflection, quiet optimism, subtle connection
